comment: Prof Barber is the best. Super kind and relatable guy. Had him like 3 years ago but still think back to that class

He's extremely nice but grades a little harder than he needs to considering most of your grade is determined by the midterm and final. Lectures are for the most part clear, focus on what he says not just what is on the slides.

I LOVE PROF BARBER. As someone with a lot of learning disabilities who is scared of school, I was never more excited to come to a night 3 hour class. He gives us breaks and makes his lectures incredibly engaging. He does not make you feel stupid for getting something wrong or asking questions. A true GEM of a human being. I love him and his class!

Professor Barber truly makes a long class bearable. He is witty and weaves his personal experience into his lectures since he works in health care. His memes are also funny. The best part of the class is his enthusiasm. I love him and his class is super easy just put in the effort.

Professor Barber, being an avid member of the Health Policy world, is a great instructor for an intro class to Health Policy. His lectures weave his own personal accounts into the material to make the learning applicable to the real world, and his enthusiasm and care for the students is terrific. Very easy to make an A if you put in some effort.
